title: Inform about critical system messages, e.g. CPU cooling problem
line: Plasma now warns you with a notification when the computer gets close to the temperature at which it would turn itself off.
explanation: When a CPU or other thermal zone reaches its critical trip point, the kernel shuts the computer down immediately. Plasma never looked at temperatures, so the user got no warning, lost unsaved work and had to dig through the system journal to learn why. PowerDevil now reads the kernel's thermal zones every 5 seconds and shows a critical, persistent "Computer Overheating" notification once a zone is within 5 °C of its critical point (or past its "hot" point, if lower); it closes again once the temperature has dropped another 5 °C.

commits.message:
daemon: warn when the computer is close to overheating

At a thermal zone's critical trip point the kernel turns the computer
off with no warning, so work is lost and the user doesn't know why.
PowerDevil now watches those zones and warns with a notification first.

BUG: 389545

media.caption: Thermal zone at 93 °C, 2 °C below its 95 °C critical point: no warning at all
Same temperature with the fix: a critical "Computer Overheating" notification
